ideas.truth: Long highway drives make hunger sharper — the first hot meal after hours on the road feels like relief, not just food.
ideas.moment: A family pulls off NH-48 mid-weekend-drive, starving, and the thali arrives steaming at their table.
ideas.key_frame: A brass thali loaded with roti, dal, sabzi, rice, and raita, steam rising, set on a rustic wooden dhaba table with a highway dusk glow in the soft background.

ideas.truth: A family thali isn't measured in grams — it's measured in nobody having to share their favourite dish.
ideas.moment: A weekend family outing where everyone gets their own thali instead of splitting one plate.
ideas.key_frame: Two identical steaming brass thalis side by side on a wooden table, each fully loaded, with warm dhaba lighting and a soft blurred rustic backdrop.

ideas.truth: At a good dhaba, you eat with your eyes first — the sizzle, steam, and ghee shine are the real advertisement.
ideas.moment: The exact second the thali is placed down and the ghee catches the light before the first bite.
ideas.key_frame: Close-up of a brass thali being set down, ghee glistening on dal, steam curling up, roti stacked to the side, warm tungsten dhaba light.

why: It's the most universal and instantly relatable moment for anyone who's ever driven NH-48, and it naturally justifies a weekend-only offer without forcing it.
treatment: We open on a highway dusk — NH-48 stretching into the distance, dust settling as a family's car pulls up. Cut to the dhaba's rustic wooden table, empty for a beat, inviting. Then the hero shot: a brimming brass thali is set down, steam rising off dal and sabzi, roti stacked warm, rice mounded, raita cool and white against the metal. Ghee catches the light. The mood is warm, unhurried, appetite-building — like the plate itself is saying 'you made it, now eat.' No people needed in the final frame; the food does the talking. Bottom third of the frame stays clean and uncluttered for the offer text and location line to sit over a soft-focus tabletop area.

scenes.prompt: An Instagram product ad photo of a single brimming brass thali placed on a rustic dark-wood dhaba table, steam gently rising off a bowl of dal and a mound of steamed rice, three warm stacked rotis to one side, a small bowl of cool white raita, a wedge of lemon, and glistening ghee catching warm tungsten light. Shot from a slight overhead angle, shallow depth of field, softly blurred warm dhaba interior in the background with hints of an amber highway glow through a window. Leave the lower third of the frame as a calm, softly out-of-focus empty tabletop area for text overlay. Style: warm, appetizing, cozy highway-dhaba realism, rich amber and brown tones, natural steam and light, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
